entities.summary: The Mahābhārata is a Hindu smriti epic poem from ancient India, one of the two important epics of Hinduism known as the Itihasas, the other being the Ramayana. It is also the longest poem ever written, consisting of over 100,000 verses. It narrates the events and aftermath of the Kurukshetra War, a war of succession between two groups of princely cousins, the Kauravas and the Pāṇḍavas. It contains philosophical and devotional material, such as a discussion of the four "goals of life" or puruṣārtha (12.161).
